packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'Build and Test (.NET)' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors. EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory is deliberately NOT listed: although test-only, it belongs to the 'dotnet monorepo' group that bumps EF Core and the .NET runtime in lockstep, and matching one member would leak automerge onto that framework-wide PR.
Build-time only: SourceLink and reproducible-build SDKs emit nothing at runtime, so a bad version fails the build rather than reaching production.
